DE_load_forecast_entsoe_transparency.raw_redistribution: permitted with attribution and indication of changes
DE_load_forecast_entsoe_transparency.used_for: hourly demand multipliers (shape and level relative to the nearest 1 January)
DE_load_forecast_entsoe_transparency.committed_derivative: 24 hourly ratios per stress day (4 decimals); CC BY 4.0, attribution in license.load_forecast_attribution

DE_load_actual_entsoe_transparency.used_for: stress-day detection only (highest-load and combined criteria)
DE_load_actual_entsoe_transparency.committed_derivative: the selected dates only; no value or statistic

DE_solar_capacity.committed_derivative: one MODELED daily multiplier per carrier and stress day (ratio of daily-mean CFs, rounded to 0.05, clipped to <= 1); no hourly value, no daily-mean CF, no MW value

license.opsd_package: No data licence in datapackage.json (licenses: null); the OPSD page states 'Text is licensed under CC-BY license' (text only). OPSD notes primary data originate in ENTSO-E Transparency; capacities have separate per-column sources.
license.load_forecast_attribution: Day-ahead forecast of the total load per market time unit, Germany (Reg. (EU) 543/2013 Art. 6.1.b), ENTSO-E Transparency Platform (https://transparency.entsoe.eu/), obtained via Open Power System Data, Time series 2020-10-06 (https://doi.org/10.25832/time_series/2020-10-06), column DE_load_forecast_entsoe_transparency. Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) per the ENTSO-E list of data available for free re-use (2023-10-18), item #1. Changes made by GridStorm: the stress day's 24 hourly values are divided by the mean of the nearest 1 January (UTC), then by the scigrid-de network's normalized hourly load, and rounded to 4 decimals; only these ratios are published.
license.assessment: Checked 2026-11-15 (docs/research/entsoe-reuse-check.md). The hourly demand multipliers derive only from the ENTSO-E day-ahead total load forecast (Reg. (EU) 543/2013 Art. 6.1.b), item #1 of the ENTSO-E free re-use list of 2023-10-18 and therefore CC BY 4.0 with attribution and indication of changes. Actual load (Art. 6.1.a) and actual generation (Art. 16.1.b/c) are NOT on that list and remain subject to the Primary Owners' rights (Terms of Use 29/03/2023 cl. 3.1/5.1); no permission has been obtained, so nothing from which their hourly values can be reconstructed is committed: they only select the stress dates and set one daily renewable multiplier per carrier, rounded to 0.05. Capacities are OPSD calculations based on BNetzA and netztransparenz.de (no data licence declared); no capacity value is committed. Per-column detail: source.column_reuse.
license.committed_content: Per stress day: 24 hourly demand multipliers from the CC BY 4.0 load forecast; one MODELED daily availability multiplier per renewable carrier (ratio of daily-mean observed CF to daily-mean network CF, rounded to 0.05, clipped to <= 1); the stress and reference dates and the detection criteria. No OPSD series, no observed MW value or statistic and no hourly observed capacity factor. pipelines/observed/tests/test_reuse.py attempts the reconstruction: the actual hourly load misses by more than 500 MW and the hourly observed CF by more than 10 % of the day's peak CF, even with an oracle scale fitted to the observed values.

attribution: Open Power System Data. 2020. Data Package Time series. Version 2020-10-06. https://doi.org/10.25832/time_series/2020-10-06. (Primary data from various sources, for a complete list see URL). German load forecast and load/generation: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform; German capacities: OPSD calculations based on BNetzA and netztransparenz.de.
missing_value_policy: No interpolation or filling. Hours absent from the source or empty are NaN; any UTC day/window with a NaN hour is excluded from detection; a mapped day must be complete.
